commands.name: ladder propose

fixed_cost.description: one-off cost of the batch (a kiln firing, a print run), in dollars

margin.description: smallest profit, in dollars, every step must make at its threshold (default 0)

minimum.description: fewest buyers for which the drop goes ahead

start_price.description: top price every buyer authorises; chosen from the costs when left out

steps.description: how many price steps, including the first (default 4)

unit_cost.description: what one item costs to make, in dollars

commands.summary: Propose a price ladder from costs, with the profit at every step.

commands.name: drop create

ladder.description: buyers:price pairs like 30:40,45:36,60:33 (the first must equal the minimum)

minimum.description: fewest buyers for which the drop goes ahead

minutes.description: how long the drop runs once published (max 4320 = 72 h)

start_price.description: top price each buyer holds (with --from-proposal, or above the ladder's first price)

unit_cost.description: cost to make one item, in dollars
